inference_config.scope: strict online ABC with bounded private memory/template/motion restoration
inference_config.gt_input: only first annotation initializes; later GT only offline scoring

protocol.localization: valid RGB/TIR max IoU; failure<.2, correct>=.5; initialization excluded
protocol.candidate0: original GOLA Hann winner within the selected branch search
protocol.c1: frozen C1 choice within exactly the same branch search
protocol.pollution: actual prior template source frame/box; localization proxy, unknown excluded
protocol.learned_memory: recorded slot update coefficients reconstruct known/wrong localization contribution mass; protected initialization trusted; not semantic identity purity
protocol.forecast: next H GT from current frame; normalized centers/log sizes; modalities separate
protocol.coverage: union per-mode center rectangles with 90% coordinate bands; not nominal joint90%
protocol.area: sum per-mode normalized center rectangle areas, overlaps counted
protocol.future_head: fixed-C1 counterfactual target evaluated on held-out cache, not future ABC rollout
